description_en: Updates the settings of a Smart Access Gateway (SAG) device port
description_zh: 调用ModifySagManagementPort修改智能接入网关设备管理口配置
kebab_example: aliyun smartag modify-sag-management-port --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --smart-ag-id sag-whfn0000 --smart-ag-sn sag32a300000 --ip 192.XX.XX.1 --mask 255.255.255.0 --gateway 192.XX.XX.254 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifySagManagementPort
